Ready to take responsibility in a modern production environment? At McCain Appetizers in Rilland, we're looking for motivated Line Operators who enjoy rolling up their sleeves and making a difference. Previous experience is not essential—we're looking for enthusiasm, commitment, and a willingness to learn. Together, we'll ensure our cheese snacks and breaded vegetable products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

What are you going to do?
As a Line Operator, you’ll ensure that the production process runs smoothly and efficiently. You’ll work with modern machinery and monitor the progress of the production line.

- Setting up and operating production machines

- Monitoring and adjusting the production process

- Ensuring that raw materials and supplies are available on time

- Identifying and resolving minor malfunctions

-Collaborating with colleagues to ensure quality and continuity

You'll work in a rotating 3-shift schedule, ensuring production continues around the clock. Your shifts are:

- Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM
- Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
- Night shift: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM

What do we offer?
-Starting salary of €17,17 per hour (including ATV allowance, excluding shift premiums)

-Shift premium: 33% extra after 6:00 p.m. and 35% extra after midnight

-25 vacation days

-3% year-end bonus

-Travel allowance

-Career growth and development opportunities through training

-As a flex worker, you also have the prospect of a permanent contract with McCain

Where will you work?
McCain Appetizers in Rilland is a dynamic and no-nonsense manufacturing company specializing in frozen, breaded snack products made from vegetables and cheese. As a global market leader, we operate in an international environment where Dutch and English are spoken. Quality, collaboration, and ownership are central to our culture.

What do we ask?
-Proficiency in Dutch and/or English

-Availability to work in a 3-shift rotation
